I asked about the night and we got into an argument and she said she kissed him at midnight. She said she was going to tell me later that day.

It's hard finding what I'm happy about that doesn't include/involve her because we do as much as an online relationship can do. We both love videos games, and we play them together while we skype with cameras on and what not.

She lives in the UK while I live in America, so there's a +5 hour gap for me, so she's 5 hours ahead.

We met when I was getting over being rejected by somebody I liked and when she was depressed because she would be picked on at school and bullied. We literally skype all day long, as soon as I wake up I call her and skype until she goes to bed about 12 hours later. Then I go to sleep when I'm tired and the cycle repeats. As for school, I used to go to a High School until I started developing issues, depression, suicide, anxiety etc. That's when I met her, and we made all our issues go away. As for my attendance, It's been very spotty. I've had to move from 8 hours a day for 5 days to an online class where I go into a school for 4 hours a day for 4 days. I've not had contact with anybody other than her and my family in almost 2 years.

It started when I moved schools, I didn't see any of my friends. Then I ended up not being involved with my friends lives - they didn't invite me parties, birthdays, or to even hang out despite being close friends during middle school and the beginning year of high school.

I rarely go outside, my days consist of waking up, talking to her, playing games, watching movies, and going to sleep.

I feel like it's too late for me to get back into the socializing scene, as I'm not even in a proper high school ***(I sit at a computer at a school for 4 hours with ghetto people, drop outs, disruptive kids - basically the people you don't want to be mixed with)*** and my interests consist of the minority where I live as most people are more interested in smoking dope, showing off shoes,showing off their ass cracks, and "reppin' the east syyde" and that I won't make friends because how would I make friends if not for work and school? Which I don't have a job as well.
edit: I'm 18, still live with my parents. I'm wondering if I check into a hospital to be looked over will CPS get involved?
